$comment: Stage spec: target_intel. Passive intel collection (DNS / ASN / whois / CT). L1 passive_intel. Phase A.
$comment_findings_allowed: Passive-intel stage: the deliverable is observations (claims) + the 6-technique coverage matrix, NOT vulnerabilities. submit_stage_deliverable drops any findings submitted here and tells the model to put discoveries in claims. Design 2026-06-15-recon-stage-findings-suppression.

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: Phase 0+1 (2026-06-12-redteam-phase0/phase1) + 2026-06-23 provider-source closure: 'found' for all 6 passive intel techniques is decided by DB/ledger truth, not self-report. Landing per technique is provider/registry-tool backed: SUBDOMAIN/DNS-adjacent asset mapping→target_assets/dns_records when available from provider landing, ASN/CT/OSINT→organizations.asns/.certificates/.intel via recon_map_assets, WHOIS→organizations.whois via recon_lookup_whois. target_intel no longer allows scan-tool fallback; missing/unavailable provider data must be submitted as terminal checked_empty/blocked/not_applicable. Tagging a claim or hand-writing a found cell no longer counts.

on_fail.reason: intel coverage incomplete: some (in-scope asset × expected intel technique) cells were never attempted
hints: for every in-scope asset, give each expected intel technique a terminal status: found / checked_empty / blocked|not_applicable+note

the gate reads the DATABASE, not your self-report: a cell is 'found' only if the provider/registry tool ran and its data landed (recon_map_assets→target_assets/organizations.*, recon_lookup_whois→organizations.whois, provider DNS landing→dns_records where available) — tagging a claim is not enough

no provider/credential for a technique (e.g. OSINT, CT, ASN, DNS or SUBDOMAIN provider survey)? record it blocked+note — never fabricate; run only the target_intel registry tools to make found cells real

BREAK THE LOOP: if a technique's provider/source is unavailable or keeps failing, submit that (asset x technique) cell as status=blocked with a note naming the failed/absent source. A blocked cell is TERMINAL and clears the gap; do NOT resubmit the same matrix expecting that cell to fill, it will loop forever.

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: Provider-source closure Phase 3: source_query_log rows are required as source-attempt proof for provider-backed found/checked_empty intel. They do NOT make a cell found; found is still DB/ledger truth. blocked/not_applicable cells with a note are terminal and do not force a provider call.

on_fail.reason: intel source coverage incomplete: some provider/source attempts have no terminal source_query_log row
hints: run target_intel registry tools once: recon_map_assets records providerStatus rows for DNS/SUBDOMAIN/ASN/CT/OSINT provider survey, recon_lookup_whois records the RDAP WHOIS source row
do not call shell discovery tools in target_intel; they are not allowed in this stage
if a source/provider is unavailable, submit blocked or not_applicable coverage with a non-empty note naming the source instead of rerunning the same provider loop

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: Phase C (design 2026-06-22-intel-perdim-freshness-slim-deliverable, 瘦身交付物): target_intel adjudicates coverage from DB truth (facts_from_db_truth + coverage_complete authoritative_found above), so the agent submits a SLIM deliverable — it runs the collection tools and lets the DB-truth projection fill the matrix. Requiring a technique-tagged claim/finding per found cell contradicts that, so coverage_corroborated is an explicit no-op here. Kept (not deleted) to document intent and stay available to any future non-authoritative intel stage. Completeness is still enforced by coverage_complete (authoritative, reads the DB); a vacuous/empty submission still BLOCKs via vacuous_check + empty DB truth.

on_fail.reason: every 'found' intel coverage cell must be corroborated by a technique-tagged claim/finding on the same asset
hints: tag each intel claim/finding with its `technique` id (GOLISH-INTEL-DNS / -WHOIS / -ASN / -CT / -SUBDOMAIN / -OSINT)
use the SAME subject string as the coverage cell's asset

$comment_expected_techniques: 被动情报技术类（GOLISH-INTEL-* 命名空间，登记于 technique_taxonomy.json）。coverage_complete 据此核每个 in-scope 资产是否每类情报技术都有终态；in-scope 资产集由 harness 外层从 recon 资产库（targets.scope='in'）注入 GateContext，缺则回退自报。无 coverage_denominator（被动情报无 enumeration 分母）。
$comment_stage_run: stage_run fan-out (design 2026-06-13-stage-run-fanout §3.2): specialist = the per-org sub-agent the stage_run tool fans out (intel → recon, the passive collector split from Pentester); coverage_axis = the human-readable technique columns the StageRunView renders per org row.
$comment_min_invocations: 2026-06-23 target_intel provider-source boundary: no scan-tool selectors are exposed in this zero-touch stage. SUBDOMAIN/DNS/ASN/CT/OSINT coverage remains required, but found states must come from provider/registry-tool landing (primarily recon_map_assets; WHOIS via recon_lookup_whois). If no configured provider/source can land a technique, the agent must record blocked/checked_empty/not_applicable with evidence or note instead of running a CLI fallback. 2026-06-17 passive-intel-closure Phase F removed the dns_resolve / subdomain_enum_passive hard floors; completeness is enforced by coverage_complete (authoritative_found, reads the DB). Historical context (pre-Phase F): DNS + passive subdomain were mandatory hard floors; OSINT was deliberately never a hard floor (ENScan_GO is China-corp-focused, not every engagement has an OSINT provider) and stays a REQUIRED coverage cell that may be terminal as blocked+note.
$comment_facts_from_db_truth: design 2026-06-15-db-truth-single-source-deliverable §5 PR2: target_intel is facts-only — coverage/claims/evidence are adjudicated from DB truth (coverage_complete authoritative + coverage_truth). With this on, vacuous_check is satisfied by real DB/ledger evidence facts so a weak model need not hand-copy a deliverable; completeness is still enforced by coverage_complete per (in-scope asset × technique). Empty DB truth still blocks.
$comment_freshness_window: Phase E activation (design 2026-06-22-intel-perdim-freshness-slim-deliverable): gray-switch ON. The coverage gate's DB-truth projection (org intel ASN/CT/WHOIS/OSINT + per-asset DNS/SUBDOMAIN) now only counts data collected at/after this stage-run start (operation_state.stage_started_at), so a row left by a PREVIOUS run no longer satisfies a cell this run (execute.rs reads this flag -> threads run_start into db_truth_facts -> coverage_truth windows each dim). Requires the write-path *_collected_at stamping (migration 20260622000001) to be live. Default false = presence-only; flip back to false to disable instantly.
$comment_host_aware_coverage: design 2026-06-15-host-aware-coverage (Phase 2a): coverage_complete holds each in-scope asset only to the intel techniques that apply to its class — a bare IP/CIDR is NOT asked for SUBDOMAIN / forward-DNS / CT (domain-only concepts); WHOIS/ASN/OSINT still apply to every class. Fixes IPs being permanently 'incomplete'. Asset class is inferred from the asset value (IpAddr/url/cidr/else domain); unknown keeps the full set (fail-safe, never relaxes the gate).
$comment_coverage_anchor_only: design 2026-06-16-coverage-anchor-axis: this stage declares 'no enumeration denominator' (see $comment_expected_techniques) — the coverage denominator is the scoped ROOT/anchor assets, NOT the subdomains it passively enumerates. But the recon worker registers each discovered subdomain as a scope='in' target, which (read live by coverage_complete) inflated the (asset × technique) matrix during the very stage it gates — the 'treadmill' that drove every org to its 40-iteration cap and BLOCK. With this on, coverage_complete drops any in-scope asset that is a strict subdomain of another in-scope asset before deriving the matrix; the root's own SUBDOMAIN cell still represents the enumeration. Maximal roots always remain so a non-empty axis never becomes empty.
